page_title: UNI 3-1 MON | Union Berlin v B. Monchengladbach 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+1' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+1' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
86' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' Substitution. Paul Jaeckel (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Robin Gosens walks off.
83' The attendance for today's match is 22012.
82' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow was alert and made a comfortable save.
80' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Tomas Cvancara will be replaced by Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
77' 3 - 1 Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the top right corner. Excellent finish.

75' 3 - 0 Goal! Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Moritz Nicolas had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:0.
74' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin Behrens.
74' Nenad Bjelica prepares a substitution. Kevin Volland is replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin).
73' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
73' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
73' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
73' Referee Martin Petersen sees the trip by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Union Berlin win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
70' Here comes a substitution. Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Rocco Reitz.
70' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Luca Netz.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joe Scally will be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
69' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
65' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Martin Petersen had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
62' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
61' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) replacing Benedict Hollerbach.
60' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
60' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is replacing Christoph Kramer.
58' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:2.

57' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Moritz Nicolas displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
56' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
56' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) heads on.
54' Dangerous play by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach). Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.

50' 2 - 0 Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0 with this magnificent strike.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
49' An attempted cross from Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is cleared. Union Berlin earn a corner.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach). Martin Petersen doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
47' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+3' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the right-hand post, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
45+2' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
45+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Martin Petersen couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) and blew his whistle.
41' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
40' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
38' None of the Union Berlin players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
38' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
36' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
36' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) will deliver the corner kick.
35' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
33' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
32' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is able to continue to play.
30' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Martin Petersen ignores the protests.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.

26' A lofted cross from Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach win a corner kick.
26' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Martin Petersen blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Moritz Nicolas no chance!
23' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is going to take the penalty!

22' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Union Berlin.
21' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.

18' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the left post.
18' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

18' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) fails to beat a perfect example of the offside trap.
16' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
15' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
12' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
10' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
9' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
7' Martin Petersen blows his whistle. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
3' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Martin Petersen didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
1' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Martin Petersen.
